build_timm_vision_tower: build a timm model adapter as a vision tower for CLIP with configurable pooling and projection
create_timm_model_with_pooling: create a TimmModel instance with absolute attention pooling and linear projection for image embeddings
lock_timm_model_params: lock all or partial parameters of a TimmModel trunk to freeze layers during fine-tuning
enable_grad_checkpointing: enable gradient checkpointing on a TimmModel trunk to reduce memory usage during training
forward_timm_model: run a forward pass through a TimmModel to extract image embeddings from input tensors
